Seven goals, a statement win, and a semi-final spot sealed!
India continued their unbeaten run at the Women's Asian Champions Trophy with a commanding 7-0 victory over Thailand. Deepika's hat-trick, Navneet Kaur's brace and goals from Mumtaz Khan and Sunelita Toppo powered the defending champions to another dominant win!
